provenance.sourceOrg: Office of the Governor of Georgia
provenance.quote: Shall the Act be approved which provides a homestead exemption from City of West Point ad valorem taxes for municipal purposes in the amount of $10,000.00 of the assessed value of the homestead for residents of that city?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Exempts $10,000 of a qualifying West Point resident’s assessed homestead value from city property taxes, including city bond taxes, beginning January 1, 2027 if voters approve. The homestead may include no more than five contiguous acres; assessed value above the exemption remains taxable. The exemption adds to other city-tax homestead exemptions and does not apply to state, county or school property taxes. The resident or an agent must apply to the city or its designee; the exemption then renews while the home remains the resident’s homestead, and recipients must report loss of eligibility.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the additional $10,000 city-tax homestead exemption for tax years beginning in 2027.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject the proposed additional city-tax exemption.
